title: EGI-BENCH: An Enterprise General Intelligence Benchmark Suite
reasons: 新基准贡献、任务、评分协议、模型比较及资源线索达到自动筛选门槛；资源内容尚未核实
missingSignals: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We release EGI-BENCH, a unified LLM agent benchmark suite that consolidates eight enterprise facing agent benchmarks (CRMARENA, HERB, PERSONABENCH, USERBENCH, MCP-UNIVERSE, MCPEVAL, BENCHFORCE, LOCOBENCH) behind a single command-line interface with two runtime-budgeted execution modes.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Enterprise adoption of LLMs in agentic workflows is gated by evaluations that span a wide arc of abilities: CRM operations, heterogeneous-document retrieval, personal data understanding, multi-turn planning, tool use, function calling, long-horizon research, and long-context software engineering.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: These evaluations live today in separate repositories with divergent runners, dependencies, and scoring conventions, which makes cross-benchmark comparison difficult and obscures what a single aggregate number actually represents.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: These evaluations live today in separate repositories with divergent runners, dependencies, and scoring conventions, which makes cross-benchmark comparison difficult and obscures what a single aggregate number actually represents.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Top-line EGI ranges from 39.6 (GPT-4o mini) to 65.6 (gpt-5.5), and no single model dominates every capability axis: gpt-5.5 leads task outcome, planning, and retrieval grounding; Claude Sonnet 4.5 leads tool actioning and safety/abstention; and Claude Haiku 4.5 leads engineering quality.
